stories.description3: Not temporary fixes, but long-term recovery is what we aim for.

hero.desc: Every individual's needs are different. Our expert team helps you regain your health with treatment plans tailored to you.

category.header: Find the Right Treatment for Your Needs
category.desc: With a wide range of specialties, we offer you the treatment method best suited to you.

box.desc1: Comprehensive recovery programs following fractures, dislocations, joint replacements, and musculoskeletal injuries.
box.desc2: Therapies focused on functional gains and independence in stroke, brain injury, and nervous system disorders.
box.desc3: Pain management, injury prevention, and performance enhancement programs tailored to athletes.
box.desc4: Hands-on techniques to improve joint range of motion, reduce pain, and restore tissue.
box.desc5: Targeted needle therapy to release muscle spasms and trigger points. An effective solution for chronic pain.
box.desc6: Building strength, flexibility, and balance through personalized exercise plans. Home continuation programs included.

details.header: A Scientific Approach Behind Every Treatment
details.desc: The methods we use are backed by internationally evidence-based protocols.

orthopedic.desc: Following surgery or traumatic injuries, joint replacements, and fracture or dislocation treatments, we carry out one-on-one rehabilitation guided by expert physiotherapists. Functional goals are set at every stage and progress is assessed regularly.

list.li1: Early mobilization after knee and hip replacement
list.li3: Functional recovery in elbow and wrist injuries
list.li4: Conservative treatment for lower back and neck hernias
list.li5: Rapid return-to-sport protocols for sports injuries

neurological.desc: In stroke, brain and spinal cord injuries, and neurological conditions, we focus on helping patients regain independence in daily life. Our specially trained team works with current methods based on the nervous system's capacity to learn (neuroplasticity).

list.li1: Gait and balance training after stroke
list.li2: Functional therapy with Bobath and PNF concepts
list.li3: Movement management in multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's
list.li4: Treatment of spasticity and coordination disorders
list.li5: Building independence in activities of daily living

sports.desc: For amateur and professional athletes, we offer return-to-play, injury prevention, and performance enhancement programs. The process is planned together with a sports physician and shaped specifically around each athlete's discipline.

list.li2: Load management in muscle and tendon injuries

manual.desc: Using hands-on mobilization and manipulation techniques, we improve joint mobility, reduce pain, and relieve muscle tension. Each session is tailored to the individual following a detailed assessment.

list.li2: Soft tissue and fascia release applications
list.li3: Trigger point therapy and myofascial techniques
list.li4: Hands-on treatment for neck and lower back pain
